decision: After publishing this in-training comparison, inspect the feasibility of a separately registered, bounded comparison on two fixed unused development trajectories.
basis: Training-sample agreement improved while the two-seed game screen failed its guardrail; development-state comparison may clarify teacher imitation without reusing consumed holdout results as tuning data.
boundaries: Same-seed development trajectories are not independent holdout evidence. No extra games, training, strategy changes, replacement samples or use of raw holdout data.
